question: Should memory-lancedb autoCapture reject OpenClaw external-content wrappers by default, or should users opt into wrapper exclusion through a new captureFilter config option?
rationale: The source-level gap is concrete, but the durable choice changes security defaults, plugin config surface, and operator expectations.

options.title: Default wrapper rejection
options.body: Treat OpenClaw-authored external-content wrappers as a host-owned capture boundary before `shouldCapture`, with regression tests and docs.

options.title: Add captureFilter config
options.body: Introduce the requested `captureFilter.excludeWrapped` setting with schema, manifest, docs, and tests while preserving current defaults.

options.title: Defer to provenance architecture
options.body: Keep the narrow issue open until the broader source-provenance and trust-tagging design defines the canonical policy.

recommendation.title: Default wrapper rejection
recommendation.body: Treat OpenClaw-authored external-content wrappers as a host-owned capture boundary before `shouldCapture`, with regression tests and docs.
